title: H&M Beauty names actress Sharvari first-ever Indian brand ambassador
summary: As H&M Beauty’s first India ambassador, actress Sharvari will lead the brand’s beauty communication in the region’s fast-growing beauty market, including promoting a new make-up assortment for Christmas 2026

extraction.key_fact: 에이치앤엠 뷰티가 배우 샤르바리를 최초의 인도 브랜드 앰버서더로 발탁했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: H&M Beauty names actress Sharvari first-ever Indian brand ambassador
